name: NG exhaustion chain Phase-1 54-week execution protocol
purpose: Scale Phase-1 to the 54 unaffected historical weeks without changing detector, endpoint, week-boundary, chain-definition, or characteristics-wall semantics, while reserving 20260329 as a later insert-only out-of-time repair fold.

canonicalization.reason: Avoid holding dozens of six-day MBP-10 week arrays in memory simultaneously; each week is processed independently through the existing canonical detector functions and then merged deterministically.

validation.inner_tuning: Inside each training era only, use the final one-sixth of training weeks as chronological validation and all preceding training weeks for fitting; never tune on the outer test era or untouched confirmation era.
validation.uncertainty: Report week-block bootstrap confidence intervals over outer-test week gains where applicable; do not rely on pooled event counts alone.

structural_depth.extension_reason: The full-history campaign is explicitly intended to let the data determine how far sequential memory propagates; the added depths are preregistered before 54-week results are read.
structural_depth.stop_rule: After two successive depths lack reproducible out-of-time incremental support, still compute deeper preregistered depths only as sensitivity; they cannot define a Phase-1 boundary without renewed preregistration.
structural_depth.knn_sensitivity: KNN remains a model-family sensitivity check. To keep the full-history run computationally bounded, use deterministic evenly-spaced samples within training and test weeks; KNN may contradict or weaken a finding but cannot by itself create a confirmed depth.

attacks: threshold sensitivity without changing the canonical detector

repair_week_insert.optional_refit_after_insert_for_descript: Allowed only if clearly separated from the frozen out-of-time insert score and it may not overwrite the 54-week evidence artifacts.
